caption: The video captures a white sealant tube with a black label and green logo held above a glossy black surface. Its nozzle sits at the start of a continuous white bead that runs diagonally toward the right, extruding sealant onto the surface. The bead stays joined to the nozzle throughout, indicating sealant is being laid. The tube and nozzle drift slowly leftward and slightly upward, so the bead's tip moves with them while the laid portion remains on the surface and the diagonal line shifts its angle. A mirror reflection of the tube, nozzle and bead tracks this motion below, and a second white line already runs along the top-right back edge. The perspective shifts gradually.
relations: Nozzle extrudes continuous white bead onto glossy black surface, bead staying joined to nozzle during extrusion.
Tube drifting leftward and upward moves bead tip while laid bead remains fixed on surface.
Mirror reflection below tracks tube, nozzle and bead motion as perspective shifts gradually.
Second white line along top-right back edge persists as diagonal bead angle shifts.
